It updates helper routines for unary and binary FP folding to accept APFloat operands, reworks several intrinsic-folding cases to use APFloat-based predicates and operations such as isZero/isNegative, copySign, minnum/maxnum/minimum/maximum, fusedMultiplyAdd, and cube intrinsic folding, and only converts to native double at the point of invoking libm-style functions. This changes the semantics boundary between LLVM’s APFloat constant representation and host floating-point evaluation, which is directly relevant to floating-point folding correctness and representability-sensitive crashes.
